replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Apart from the wrong format, you have been tempbanned for encouraging suicide, to be exact for telling another player "KYS" in a public match.
The evidence can be found here: https://gyazo.com/8b2b70b0f7c8e77246ae56b6897f6e14
Also we don't warn someone when they tell others to kill themselves, we temporary ban them straight away, because it's a sensitive topic and you never know how serious the other player takes what you have said.

Since evidence was provided, you used the wrong format and have been punished according to the guidelines, this appeal is Denied.

I'm going to leave this open for the next 24 hours in case you have any questions.
